description: This file defines the 'SudoRetrievePolicyResponse' class, which is an immutable Java class representing the response to a 'SudoRetrievePolicy' command within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating instances from JSON strings or objects, accessors for its policy data, and overrides for equality, hashing, and string representation.

classes.name: SudoRetrievePolicyResponse
classes.description: An immutable class representing the response to a 'SudoRetrievePolicy' command, encapsulating policy data and associated metadata, with methods for JSON serialization/deserialization and response handling.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a new instance with specified PolicyId, Policy, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a response instance from a JSON string or object, given headers.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the PolicyId associated with this response.

methods.name: getPolicy
methods.description: Returns the Policy object as constructed from the JSON policy.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the JSON representation of the policy.

methods.name: setEntity
methods.description: Returns a new response instance with the provided JSON entity.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new response instance with updated headers.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends the policy ID and policy JSON to the response payload.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks for equality based on policy ID, policy, and superclass fields.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on the response contents.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the response, including policy ID and policy json.
